title: Coddle, Kowtow, and Delight II
description: Coddle, Kowtow, and Delight II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Junior Exec Ivan

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 15 Ice Orok AC Repairmen and 3 Ice Orok AC Overseers in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Junior Exec Ivan

Repeatable: No

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kill 15 Ice Orok AC Repairmen and 3 Ice Orok AC Overseers in Upper Frump's Misfortune then Return to Junior Exec Ivan in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

What did I say about these stubborn Ice Oroks?! They wouldn't listen when The Frump told them to keep the dungeon at a reasonable temperature and now they are sending in some AC Repairmen and AC Overseers to make it even colder! The Frump is mad, so now is a good time for you to get in there and grab his attention by coming through for him and removing those Ice Oroks.

These Ice Orok AC Repairmen and AC Overseers were spotted in the main areas of Upper Frump's Misfortune, so get in there and take them out. When you have met your quota return to me, Junior Exec Ivan, here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

This is getting out of hand, but you have been a huge help. When I mentioned you to The Frump earlier, he said 'Oh yeah, that Dungeon Runner' and that is a really good sign. Come on back if you want to keep it up.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Orok AC Repairmen
  • Slain Ice Orok AC Overseers

Client level range: 35–45
